categories.main_business_segments: HAXC Holdings primarily operates in the automotive electronics industry, focusing on intelligent automotive cockpit electronics. Its main business segments include core display component customization, intelligent cockpit terminal manufacturing, software system development, and distribution of general electronic components. The company also engages in integrated solutions for intelligent cockpit display systems and domain control systems, including full LCD instrument panels, head-up displays, electronic rearview mirrors, and intelligent driving assistance systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced display technologies such as Mini LED, OLED, and narrow-bezel dual-screen integration. It has developed proprietary technologies including six-axis motion control for dynamic central control screens, silent gear transmission mechanisms, and new damping technologies for automotive motion components. Production methods emphasize full-chain manufacturing from raw materials to final assembly, with a focus on modular, flexible production lines compliant with IATF 16949:2016 automotive quality standards. The company also integrates software and hardware development, including lightweight HMI engines based on domestic chips.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HAXC serves primarily automotive OEMs and system integrators, including major Chinese and international car manufacturers such as Great Wall, Geely, Changan, Chery, Ford, SAIC, XPeng, and Li Auto. It also extends into commercial vehicles, heavy trucks, and emerging sectors like low-altitude flying vehicles. The company’s products cater to the intelligent cockpit electronics market, driven by trends in vehicle electrification, connectivity, and smart driving assistance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Beijing, Jiangsu (Nantong), and Shenzhen. It has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong serving as an import, logistics, and foreign currency settlement center. Domestic sales account for over 96% of revenue, with limited overseas sales primarily in Asia. The company is expanding its international presence through overseas project platforms and strategic partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: HAXC operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain. It customizes core display components sourced from upstream panel and chip manufacturers, integrates software and hardware systems, and manufactures intelligent cockpit terminals. The company is vertically integrating by building its own intelligent manufacturing base to enhance supply chain control and reduce costs, positioning itself as a system integrator and manufacturer close to OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on technological innovation in intelligent cockpit displays, including advanced display technologies (Mini LED, OLED), dynamic interaction interfaces, and integration of AI and multi-modal human-machine interaction. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new products such as foldable screens, AR-HUD, and automotive electronic rearview mirrors with ADAS functions. The company also emphasizes domestic chip adoption to reduce costs and enhance competitiveness, while building intelligent manufacturing capabilities and quality management systems aligned with automotive and aerospace standards.
categories.revenue_model: HAXC generates revenue primarily through product sales of customized core display components, intelligent cockpit terminals, and software system development services. It employs a direct sales model, providing integrated solutions from design to manufacturing and after-sales support. Revenue is derived from bulk sales of customized components, software development contracts, and distribution of general electronic components, with no subscription or licensing models reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic provider of intelligent automotive cockpit electronics with comprehensive capabilities in both hardware and software. It competes with other automotive electronics suppliers focusing on intelligent displays and cockpit systems. Its competitive advantages include vertical integration, advanced proprietary technologies, and strong OEM relationships. The company has secured projects with major domestic and international car manufacturers, establishing barriers through long product validation cycles and customized solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, HAXC reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.035 billion, a 7.65% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in intelligent cockpit terminal business and automotive industry expansion. However, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 76 million, reflecting increased R&D and production ramp-up costs. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.344 billion with equity of RMB 1.153 billion. It is in a growth phase with significant investment in intelligent manufacturing and R&D, aiming for scale economies and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HAXC emphasizes its integrated one-stop solution capability combining customized core display components, software system development, and intelligent cockpit terminal manufacturing. Its value proposition lies in advanced display technologies, flexible and modular production, and deep integration with OEMs’ product development cycles. The company differentiates through proprietary innovations like six-axis motion screens, silent gear mechanisms, and domestic chip-based lightweight HMI engines, enabling cost-effective, high-performance, and highly customized intelligent cockpit solutions that enhance user experience and vehicle safety.
